_comment: Questions real buyers and sellers ask, in their words. The daily article job picks from here, furthest-from-existing first. This is the SEED's starter set — generic by design. The question-bank skill replaces it with the agent's own: their inbox, their showings, their Google Business questions, their voice agent transcripts. A bank of generic questions produces generic articles.
_rules: Phrase it the way a person would say it out loud, not as a keyword.

Nothing about the transaction itself — commissions, buyer agreements, closing mechanics, contingencies. That is the agent's licence to describe, not ours. See .claude/rules/legal-compliance.md section 5d.
A bank smaller than ~30 questions per article-per-day will run dry inside a month. The job reports when it does rather than writing filler.
